description: The file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/WorldHappiness.csv' is already open in JASP. This is a real dataset from the World Happiness Report containing data for 155 countries with columns including 'Happiness Score', 'GDP per Capita', 'Family', 'Life Expectancy', 'Freedom', 'Generosity', and 'Government Corruption'. Your research question is: What national-level factors best predict a country's happiness score? Using JASP's Regression module, run a Linear Regression analysis. Set 'Happiness Score' as the Dependent Variable. Add the following four Covariates (predictors): 'GDP per Capita', 'Family', 'Life Expectancy', and 'Freedom'. Under the Statistics section, ensure that coefficient estimates, model fit measures (R-squared and adjusted R-squared), and the ANOVA test are enabled. Enable collinearity diagnostics to obtain Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) values for each predictor — this is essential for checking whether the predictors are redundant. Under the Plots section, enable residual diagnostic plots: specifically a Q-Q plot of residuals and a residuals vs. predicted plot. Once the analysis is complete and all results are visible in the output panel, save the file as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/happiness_regression.jasp'.
